source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The notification popup overrides --button-padding with --button-padding-wide. The default pair is 6px 14px and compact density uses 3px 9px; ordinary button padding remains a separate token. The same patch adds 32px/30px minimum-height tokens. These declarations establish selector/density values, not computed popup layout or proof that every upstream button consumes each token.
title: Notification popup padding selects density-specific wide tokens
